name: crypto-gameplan
description: Claude Code plugins and skills by Crypto Gameplan.

plugins.name: cgp-essentials
plugins.description: The skills Crypto Gameplan uses every day, bundled for the CGP AI Lab.

plugins.name: cgp-effort
plugins.description: Picks the reasoning effort for every prompt and counts down the prompt cache, with one-click Compact and Handoff.

plugins.name: cgp-crew
plugins.description: Give a coding job to /cgp-crew and your session leads five worker agents through it: it plans, designs, briefs and reviews, and the workers write the code.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky shell commands (rm -rf, git reset --hard, git clean, force push, migrations) and shows what they would change, with Proceed and Cancel buttons. By Anthropic.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Rewrites AI-sounding text so it reads like a person wrote it, without changing what it says. By blader (Siqi Chen).

plugins.name: mattpocock-skills
plugins.description: Matt Pocock's engineering skills: grill-me, writing-for-agents, TDD, research, specs and tickets, code review and more.
